facts.fact: The Ministry of Labour and Social Security reports it on-boarded 29 of its services on the Government Service Bus, which it says serves all institutions and links to ZamPay for payments.

The ministry reports 29 of its services on-boarded to the Government Service Bus, administered on the Zambia Employment and Labour Management System (ZELMIS); these are services of one ministry, counted by the ministry.

systems.owner: Ministry of Labour and Social Security
